sourceNotes.rawContent:
Add a touch of timeless elegance to your look with this beautiful Traditional Rajasthani Pearl Beaded Bracelet Watch. Designed with premium white pearl beads, vibrant pink & green accents, and intricate meenakari-inspired charms, this watch perfectly blends tradition with modern style.
Perfect for festive occasions, Raksha Bandhan, weddings, Navratri, Teej, Karwa Chauth, and everyday ethnic wear. The adjustable chain ensures a comfortable fit for all wrist sizes.
Features
-
Traditional Rajasthani-inspired design
-
Elegant pearl bead bracelet
-
Beautiful meenakari-style charms
-
Lightweight & comfortable
-
Adjustable chain closure
-
Suitable for festive & daily wear
-
Ideal gift for women & girls
Package Includes: 1 Bracelet Watch
